summary: All 6 ACs pass. Quality gates pass (lint 0 warnings, typecheck 0 errors, tests 674/674). All 8 user flows validated via code trace and automated tests. All 3 reviewer fixes (W-1 bothPresentSinceRef sync, W-2 readyNudge reset, W-3 Unready 44px) confirmed applied. No regressions in matchmaking, challenge links, result submission, or architecture. feedback.message: WaitingLobby 'Share invite' buttons use min-h-[36px] (lines 221, 233), below the design system's 44px minimum touch target. Not a specific AC violation (AC-1 specifies 44px for Ready/Unready), but inconsistent with design conventions. Consider bumping to 44px.
feedback.action: Change min-h-[36px] to min-h-[44px] on WaitingLobby share invite buttons for design system consistency.

learnings.insight: WaitingLobby 'Share invite' buttons at lines 221 and 233 use min-h-[36px], below the design system's 44px minimum. These are new buttons in a new component introduced by this change.
learnings.action: On a follow-up pass, bump WaitingLobby share invite buttons to min-h-[44px] for design system consistency.

learnings.insight: The timeout effect at lines 604-621 now correctly reads bothPresentSinceRef synchronously (set in presence handler at line 536 before React re-renders). The cleanup at line 619 resets readyNudge. Both fixes eliminate the race condition and stale-nudge bugs flagged by the reviewer.
learnings.action: On future changes to this effect, ensure bothPresentSinceRef remains synchronously set in the presence handler, not deferred to async evaluateStart.

learnings.insight: 24 lobby tests: 14 re-implement production logic (React component logic untestable without DOM), 10 import GhostStore directly. All pass and cover AC-1 through AC-6.
learnings.action: If lobby logic is refactored, consider extracting pure functions (countdown derivation, readySlots computation) for direct import in tests.
